data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The LCG modulo bias accumulates over 10,000 draws to violate the 2-sigma fairness criterion: at least one face count falls outside [1592.0, 1741.4].","counterconditions":[{"case":"The simulation returns all six counts within [1592.0, 1741.4], falsifying the claim that the generator is unfair over this horizon.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The first-ten calibration trace does not match the hand-computed recurrence, invalidating the implementation before any count is used as evidence.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The bias, though directional, proves too small at n=10000 to exceed 2 standard deviations from the mean.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The modulus 2^31 is not divisible by 6, so the map X mod 6 has a systematic bias: residues 0 and 1 each get floor(2^31/6)+1 = 357913942 pre-images while residues 2-5 get only 357913941.
